Pay strictly per cloud run.

Metered per token — ~90% less than top frontier models

Pay strictly for metered usage with Linden 1.0 instead of bloated monthly seat subscriptions or unrouted top frontier model API bills.

Linden 1.0 intelligence + signed receipts
